☀️ Your money this morning, Tuesday 17 November

🇺🇸 Overnight in New York: a broad sell-off. The Nasdaq fell 2.5%, the S&P 500 1.9% and the Dow 1.4%.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 0.8% lower on Monday.

🛢️ Brent oil is down 1% at about $91.54 a barrel this morning. Gold is up 0.5% at about $3,874, and the rand is flat at about R16.97 to the dollar.

What it means for you: cheaper oil helps the case for a December petrol cut. Big share falls overseas can weigh on retirement savings invested in global shares, but one day's move says little about the long run.

Prices are 15-minute delayed (06:49). Education, not financial advice.
